description: Evaluate a proposed action against evidence, source allowlists, data constraints and payment limits, returning ALLOW/BLOCK with reason codes. All enabled checks must pass: evidence cannot override an over-budget payment. Set action.type to payment to activate spending checks and pass its amount with remaining_budget; contract applies to data, not action. Use this gate before execution, trust_check_spend for budget alone, or trust_validate_data for structure alone. Enforce BLOCK and fail closed on errors. Source labels are unauthenticated; instruction scanning is a limited phrase heuristic. No action execution, wallet access, policy storage or decision history. Free, unauthenticated, stateless pilot: rules apply only to this call. Usage metadata is recorded; request bodies are not stored.

inputSchema.description: Action plus the inline policy to evaluate. Nothing is executed.

action.description: Proposed action; payment additionally requires amount and remaining_budget.

amount.description: Proposed non-negative amount. Use the same currency/unit as both limits.

merchant.description: Merchant identifier; required when allowed_merchants is supplied.

type.description: Exact action type. Use payment to enable spend checks; every other non-empty value uses the non-payment checks.

allow_extra.description: With a contract, false rejects top-level data keys not present in the contract. For nested dot paths keep true and enumerate leaf constraints.

allowed_merchants.description: Optional exact, case-sensitive merchant allowlist. An empty list blocks every merchant.

additionalProperties.description: A field constraint. Optional missing values are skipped; required rejects missing, null and empty string.

enum.description: Allowed primitive values, compared without coercion.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, applied only to numeric values.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound, applied only to numeric values.

type.description: Expected JSON type; no coercion is performed.

contract.description: Map of dot-separated field paths to constraints, e.g. {"order.total":{"type":"number","min":0,"required":true}}. Inline rules apply only to this request.

data.description: JSON object to inspect; do not submit secrets or personal data.

detect_instructions.description: Scan JSON-serialized data for a small fixed phrase heuristic, with possible false positives and negatives.

evidence.description: Caller-supplied evidence labels. Presence is required by default; content and authenticity are not verified.

items.description: Evidence label; extra metadata is ignored.

source.description: Exact source identifier to match against trusted_sources.

per_transaction_limit.description: Optional inclusive maximum amount per transaction.

remaining_budget.description: Caller-supplied remaining budget; never read from a wallet or persisted by this service.

require_evidence.description: Require at least one evidence item. Setting false intentionally skips the presence check.

trusted_sources.description: Optional exact source allowlist. Every evidence source must be listed.

name: trust_check_action

outputSchema.description: Structured result, also serialized in the text content block.

checks.description: Names of the check families supported by this gate; optional checks run only when their inputs are present.

ok.description: The operation completed; does not imply the verdict is ALLOW.

reasons.description: All failed checks; empty when ALLOW.

items.description: A deterministic finding; codes identify the violated check.

row.description: Zero-based input row index, when applicable.

verdict.description: Advisory verdict. The integrator must prevent execution on BLOCK or any error.

title: Check an action against inline policy
